comparison.objective: Remove and stow all remove-before-flight items, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize, extract, transport, and bag three safety items versus precision tool use, adjustment, torque locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All three items removed from the aircraft and placed in the kit bag, with none left as debris, versus two safe stops and stable adjustment.
comparison.reason: The task is checklist completion and extraction, not commissioning. No spec versions are present; the body lacks numeric extraction, bag-containment, and release tolerances.
